headline: Kroger beats on EPS with +2.4% identical sales and 20% eCommerce growth; new CEO Foran guides softer 2026 sales.
guidance_note: FY26: identical sales ex fuel 1.0-2.0% (incl. ~130bps IRA headwind), adj FIFO op profit $5.0-5.2B, adj EPS $5.10-5.30; $2B buyback.
key_messages: Identical sales ex fuel +2.4%; adj EPS $1.28 vs $1.20 expected; revenue $34.7B slightly missed.
Adjusted eCommerce sales +20%; FY25 eCommerce sales topped $16B.
Greg Foran named CEO, prioritizing store experience, lower prices, cost cuts and eCommerce.
2026 sales outlook absorbs ~130bps hit from Medicare drug-price negotiation (IRA) in pharmacy.

consumer.pricing: New CEO plans to lower prices funded by cost cuts.

macro_read: Food-at-home spending is steady but slowing, with consumers favoring value and convenience; pharmacy price controls will damp grocer sales in 2026.

sources.label: Yahoo Finance: Kroger stock pops on Q4
